status: Initial study awaiting visual review; no production STL set selected
limitations: Stable underside corrections are baked into print-pose geometry; rotation is not exact rigid-body no-slip physics.
Phase 1 keeps the cylindrical visible profile, but different stable soles can require pose-specific props.
Groove neck design width is at least about 5.8 mm; global thickness, slicer, supports and physical tests are unverified.
STL selection and print-count optimization follow visual approval.
All geometry is discrete; no mesh animation or scene scaling is used.
Separated cube edge, axial length and end bevel are constant; only baked resting-sole corrections vary with rolling pose.
